data.description:
discovered-from:WL-0MVFRALLB0065UIW

The canonical full suite in .pi/test-config.json runs only 'npm test -- tests/cli' and 'npm test -- tests/unit'. Those path filters exclude the 107 test files under packages/herdr/src/*.test.ts. Consequently the agent test gate, the pre-push --scope full hook and the audit full-suite evidence can all report green while the herdr suite is red; the failure in WL-0MVFRALLB0065UIW was only found by a direct vitest run.

Fix options: add a suite command covering packages/herdr/src, or declare a herdr group and wire it into the gates.

Acceptance criteria:
- The declared full suite (or a gate-enforced group) executes the herdr package tests.
- run_tests.py --scope full fails when a packages/herdr/src test is red.
- Full-suite runtime impact is measured and documented.
- .pi/test-config.json, the test-config docs and CI agree on the suite.
data.title: Canonical full suite excludes the herdr package tests

data.author: Map
data.comment: Closed with reason: Won't fix (producer decision): the herdr tests will not be run as part of the canonical full suite — the producer does not want to run the herdr tests. The gap documented in this item remains known and accepted.
